checks.observation: For an actual R, two mutually disjoint members of its disjoint subfamily would form an empty-core sunflower with R. Hence H27 gives |N[R]| >= 68-27 = 41. Independent sets of the disjointness graph are intersecting SF4 subfamilies, giving independence number at most 27; a triangle is precisely three pairwise disjoint members and is forbidden.
checks.scope: H27 transfer to neighbourhood and graph invariants

R16 is explicitly restricted to size 16 with rho <=7, and Q8 permits the specified leaf overlaps. No gap in the stated degree partition or premature use of the guarded package was found at this architectural level.
checks.scope: Guarded structural imports and exhaustive maximum-degree partition

checks.method: Read direct-jin and manuscript Section 6; verified the strict integer comparison and all eight cyclic coefficient identities with a bounded standard-library calculation.
checks.observation: The strict gap is 25*11-4*68 = 3. For each i, b_i+b_(i+3)+b_(i+5) counts every fibre once and a_i twice. Since the three neighbours of any A3 index are independent, b_i <=27 holds even before surjectivity. The deficits sum to 12, forcing a_i >=1; only then is b_i >=25 inferred from an actual vertex. The resulting r_i sum is 4. This interface does not assume a complete blowup.
checks.scope: Direct Jin A3 hypothesis and nonempty-fibre interface

checks.method: Compared manuscript Abstract, Sections 2, 5.2, 7 and 8 with the contract and global-dag source-boundary discussion.
checks.observation: The strongest-located upper-68 comparison is explicitly bounded by the literature search, the lower 54 is not presented as new, and the general ground-set conjecture is distinguished from the fixed-rank claim. The manuscript explicitly excludes an end-to-end Lean claim and does not equate separate agent contexts with human or organizational independence. This check assesses the wording and division of contribution, not exhaustive priority.

The universal fifteen-triple statement has arbitrary-support quantifiers, while represented finite cores in the high-degree models are explicitly projections rather than ambient-support cutoffs.

The manuscript distinguishes its new size-68 exclusions from imported small-rank structure and from end-to-end formal verification. I found no necessary framing revision in the inspected material. This is a continue decision, not certification of every classification, family-to-model bridge or finite leaf.
